## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

All current comparison arms below used candidate `4c8be4fb6eebde7592027de17537ae563d7e1b0a` / tree `20564b514840d8248e2796b013157652bf8c921b`, except the explicitly identified BASE reproduction. New correctly sized disposable VMs were used: IPA 4608 MiB/2 vCPU and Ubuntu host 9216 MiB/4 vCPU/60 GiB. Actual guest probes before apply measured IPA MemTotal 4409.5 MiB and host 8937.2 MiB. Host free space before deployment was 55.24 GiB; `/var/lib/docker` and `/var/lib/pilot-session-store` resolved to the same filesystem through their existing ancestor. The independent fresh-chain resource probe also passed these role-contract thresholds before L4.

| Arm | Actual result |
|---|---|
| BASE `07f55a6e11cb39be0988e3b032bfa144ed5ec387`, same healthy snapshot/Wazuh-first target | ok=51 changed=17 failed=1; curl rc60 after5attempts; journal bind address already in use; docker-proxy owns8443; IPA cert MONITORING |
| Wazuh first / default18443 | L3 ok=45 changed=13 failed=0; L4 ok=57 changed=19 failed=0; L6 ok=54 changed=0 failed=0; verify27/27, skip0 |
| Explicit28443 | L3 ok=46 changed=1 failed=0; L4 ok=55 changed=2 failed=0; L6 ok=54 changed=0 failed=0; verify27/27, skip0 |
| Request occupied8443 with SS_service selected | preflight exit2, changed0 failed1; config/binary/helper/FQDN hashes, store MainPID/InvocationID and Wazuh container ID unchanged |
| Trusted certificate, wrong expected hostname | exact SS02 fails rc1/curl60 while real store remains active; restoring FQDN passes |
| Real IPA-trusted HTTPS from a different PID | direct TLS control returns401, ownership check rejects; temporary config restored and real health passes |
| Native Wazuh functionality | indexer401 and known rule-engine alert pass with both listeners, in Wazuh-first/custom environment and before fresh teardown |

The different-PID responder is an explicit negative fixture, not another real store. Its temporary unit/config were stopped/restored before subsequent chains. Both owned comparison VMs were destroyed before the fresh chain. The machine chain above proves the opposite order (store before Wazuh) and automatically tears down its two created VMs.

Earlier candidate108b7f3 ran on undersized fixture settings; CI `TestTopologyNodesMeetContractResourceMinimums` correctly rejected that fixture. Candidate4c8be4f raises resources without changing or weakening the contract/guard. All comparison/failure/fresh arms were rerun on the new candidate; old native results are historical, not reused as its proof. An earlier108b7f3 run also failed closed with not-yet-valid TLS after guest clock skew and performed single-VM automatic rollback. Current runs synchronize both owned guests to controller UTC after snapshot; strict CA/hostname checks remain enabled. Earlier setup errors (single-host inventory missing the server group, unmanaged initial evidence pointer, and forwarding multiple positional playbooks instead of supported stdin batch) were corrected before these current native comparisons; their raw failures were retained during validation.
